BiblicalUsage: tᵉshuʼâh stands behind the English phrase a crashing clamour. In Job 36:29, Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, and it appears again in Isaiah 22:2.
TheologicalSignificance: The crash of thunder over the clouds leaves me small, and I am glad the God behind it is the one I pray to.
